---
name: Request a feature
about: Suggest an improvement to the web interface or JavaScript packages
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

Before opening a request, search the [existing frontend issues](https://github.com/DMedina559/bsm-frontend/issues).
If a related request exists, add your use case there.

## Problem or use case

Describe what you are trying to do and what makes it difficult today.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you would like. Include the affected screen or package and a
concrete example where possible. An implementation proposal is optional.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workaround or alternative approach you have tried.

## Additional context

Add relevant screenshots, mockups, or examples. For requests involving backend
behavior, include the backend version and describe the frontend behavior needed.
